category_title: Immigrant students with language barriers who distrust teacher intervention
scenario_title: Role-play discussion on seeking help for bullying
minimal_context: The student and researcher are participating in a one-on-one role-play activity to suggest people a victim could talk to after a bullying incident.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that we are at the final stage of our role-play, who do you think the victim could talk to about the bullying incident?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He can only speak to his family. There is nobody at school he can trust.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What if the victim tries to talk to a teacher?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No. He should not talk to his teacher. If he complains to him, the teacher will not believe him.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why do you think the teacher wouldn't believe him?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The bully should deny what he did or he could say that the victim had said something bad for him before and then the victim couldn’t prove that this was a lie.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Now that we are at the final stage of our role-play, who do you think the victim could talk to about the bullying incident?

STUDENT: He can only speak to his family. There is nobody at school he can trust.

TUTOR: What if the victim tries to talk to a teacher?

STUDENT: No. He should not talk to his teacher. If he complains to him, the teacher will not believe him.

TUTOR: Why do you think the teacher wouldn't believe him?

STUDENT: The bully should deny what he did or he could say that the victim had said something bad for him before and then the victim couldn’t prove that this was a lie.

task.content: Suggesting people the victim could talk to after the bullying incident during the role-play activity.
task.learning_goal: Proposing ways for the victim to handle the bullying situation during the final stage of the role-play activity.

context.materials: A scarf used as a physical prop
context.social_setting: One-on-one role-play activity between the researcher and the student

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When discussing alternative ways to deal with the problem and whether the victim should talk to a teacher
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Stressed very emphatically that the victim should not talk to his teacher
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Believed that there was nobody at school the victim could trust, so he could only speak to his family
related_quotes: The bully should deny what he did or he could say that the victim had said something bad for him before and then the victim couldn ’t prove that this was a lie.

behavior_patterns.condition: During general school interactions with his teacher
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Did not communicate effectively with her at school not only because of language dif ﬁculties but because he refused to do so.
